title: Make and serve a capsule coffee (Franka, operational-space control)
text: Make a cup of coffee with the machine, using the capsule and the green mug, then stand the filled mug upright on the serving tray.
success: Success: a brew ran to completion (the pod-bay cover closed, capsule in the bay, mug under the spout, left undisturbed until it finished), and the filled mug now stands upright on the serving tray, at rest.
